```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
library(amt)
library(survival)
library(terra)
library(here)

select <- dplyr::select   # prevent terra::select() masking
filter <- dplyr::filter
```

## 1. Load the 1 h extraction

```{r load}
ele_trk_extract_etosha <- readRDS(here("outputs", "ele_trk_extract_etosha_1h.rds"))

# Checks before fitting
nrow(ele_trk_extract_etosha)                 # ~7,245,194
n_distinct(ele_trk_extract_etosha$id)        # 39
class(ele_trk_extract_etosha)                # should include "random_steps"

# Confirm 1-hour steps (median ~60 min)
ele_trk_extract_etosha |> as_tibble() |> filter(case_) |>
  summarise(median_dt_min = median(as.numeric(dt_, units = "mins"), na.rm = TRUE))
```

## 2. Unique strata and dry/wet split

```{r strata-seasons}
# Strata must be unique per elephant
cls <- class(ele_trk_extract_etosha)

if (!"step_id" %in% names(ele_trk_extract_etosha)) {
  ele_trk_extract_etosha <- ele_trk_extract_etosha |>
    mutate(step_id = paste(id, step_id_, sep = "_"))
}
head(unique(ele_trk_extract_etosha$step_id))                                   # e.g. "AG006_12"
mean(str_starts(ele_trk_extract_etosha$step_id, ele_trk_extract_etosha$id))   # should be 1

# Seasons match KAZA (wet Nov–Apr, dry May–Oct), assigned on t1_
ele_trk_extract_wet <- ele_trk_extract_etosha |> filter(month(t1_) %in% c(11, 12, 1:4))
ele_trk_extract_dry <- ele_trk_extract_etosha |> filter(month(t1_) %in% 5:10)
class(ele_trk_extract_wet) <- cls
class(ele_trk_extract_dry) <- cls

stopifnot(all(c("id", "t1_", "case_", "step_id", "aspect") %in% names(ele_trk_extract_dry)))
c(dry = nrow(ele_trk_extract_dry), wet = nrow(ele_trk_extract_wet))
```

## 3. Hydro-year coverage

```{r coverage}
coverage <- bind_rows(
  as_tibble(ele_trk_extract_dry) |> mutate(season = "dry"),
  as_tibble(ele_trk_extract_wet) |> mutate(season = "wet")
) |>
  filter(case_) |>
  mutate(hydro_year = if_else(month(t1_) >= 11, year(t1_) + 1L, year(t1_))) |>
  group_by(season, hydro_year) |>
  summarise(n_elephants = n_distinct(id), n_used = n(),
            first = min(t1_), last = max(t1_), .groups = "drop")

print(coverage, n = Inf)   # >>> NEW: actually print it
```

## 4. Base formula

```{r formula}
base_vars <- c(
  # >>> REMOVED: core_dist (~99% zeros; collared elephants stay inside the park)
  "water_rivers_dist", "tree_cover", "grassland", "shrubland",
  "cropland_dist", "urban_dist", "fence_dist", "road_dist",
  "elevation",
  "slope", "northness", "eastness", "evi", "world_pop"
)

f_base <- reformulate(c(base_vars, "strata(step_id)"), response = "case_")

# NA share per covariate (drop_na() in prep removes a row if ANY is NA)
as_tibble(ele_trk_extract_etosha) |>
  summarise(across(any_of(c(base_vars, "aspect")), ~ mean(is.na(.x)))) |>
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "var", values_to = "prop_na") |>
  arrange(desc(prop_na))
```

## 5. Prep, scaling, pooled model

```{r prep-pooled}
prep_ssf <- function(data) {
  cls <- class(data)
  out <- data |>
    mutate(
      hydro_year = if_else(month(t1_) >= 11, year(t1_) + 1L, year(t1_)),
      northness  = cos(aspect * pi / 180),
      eastness   = sin(aspect * pi / 180)
    ) |>
    drop_na(all_of(base_vars)) |>
    group_by(step_id) |>
    filter(any(case_) & any(!case_)) |>
    ungroup()
  class(out) <- cls
  out
}

dry_prep <- prep_ssf(ele_trk_extract_dry)
wet_prep <- prep_ssf(ele_trk_extract_wet)

range(ele_trk_extract_dry$aspect, na.rm = TRUE)
count(as_tibble(dry_prep), hydro_year, case_)

# Fixed scaling on all years pooled (reused for every year + the rasters)
get_scaling <- function(data, vars) {
  tibble(var  = vars,
         mean = map_dbl(vars, ~ mean(data[[.x]], na.rm = TRUE)),
         sd   = map_dbl(vars, ~ sd(data[[.x]],   na.rm = TRUE)),
         min  = map_dbl(vars, ~ min(data[[.x]],  na.rm = TRUE)),   # >>> NEW: scale_stack() clamps to this
         max  = map_dbl(vars, ~ max(data[[.x]],  na.rm = TRUE)))   # >>> NEW
}
apply_scaling <- function(data, sc) {
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(sc))) {
    data[[sc$var[i]]] <- (data[[sc$var[i]]] - sc$mean[i]) / sc$sd[i]
  }
  data
}

sc_dry <- get_scaling(dry_prep, base_vars)
sc_wet <- get_scaling(wet_prep, base_vars)

m_base_dry <- dry_prep |> apply_scaling(sc_dry) |> fit_ssf(f_base, model = FALSE)
m_base_wet <- wet_prep |> apply_scaling(sc_wet) |> fit_ssf(f_base, model = FALSE)

summary(m_base_dry)
summary(m_base_wet)
```

## 6. Per-hydro-year fits

```{r by-year}
# >>> MOVED UP: tidy_fit() is used here
tidy_fit <- function(fit) {
  s <- summary(fit$model)$coefficients
  tibble(term = rownames(s), estimate = s[, "coef"], se = s[, "se(coef)"])
}

fit_by_year <- function(prep, sc, years = NULL, min_ids = 15, min_used = 2000) {   # >>> CHANGED: min_ids 15
  cls <- class(prep)

  samples <- prep |>
    as_tibble() |>
    filter(case_) |>
    group_by(hydro_year) |>
    summarise(n_elephants = n_distinct(id), n_used = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
    mutate(passes_gate = n_elephants >= min_ids & n_used >= min_used,
           requested   = is.null(years) | hydro_year %in% years,
           fitted      = passes_gate & requested)

  keep <- samples |> filter(fitted) |> pull(hydro_year)

  fits <- map(set_names(keep), \(yr) {
    d <- prep |> filter(hydro_year == yr)
    class(d) <- cls
    d |> apply_scaling(sc) |> fit_ssf(f_base, model = FALSE)
  })

  list(samples = samples, fits = fits)
}

# >>> REMOVED: rm(yr_dry, yr_wet, coef_by_year) — errors in a fresh session / when knitting

yr_dry <- fit_by_year(dry_prep, sc_dry)
yr_wet <- fit_by_year(wet_prep, sc_wet)

print(yr_dry$samples, n = Inf)   # expect dry 2009–2011 fitted
print(yr_wet$samples, n = Inf)   # expect wet 2010–2012 fitted

coef_by_year <- bind_rows(
  map_dfr(yr_dry$fits, tidy_fit, .id = "hydro_year") |> mutate(season = "dry"),
  map_dfr(yr_wet$fits, tidy_fit, .id = "hydro_year") |> mutate(season = "wet")
)
coef_pooled <- bind_rows(
  tidy_fit(m_base_dry) |> mutate(season = "dry"),
  tidy_fit(m_base_wet) |> mutate(season = "wet")
)

# Elevation vs water: watch for large opposite-sign pairs
coef_by_year |>
  filter(term %in% c("elevation", "water_rivers_dist")) |>
  select(season, hydro_year, term, estimate) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = term, values_from = estimate) |>
  print(n = Inf)

# Anything implausibly large?
coef_by_year |> filter(abs(estimate) > 3 | se > 1)
```

## 7. Coefficient plot

```{r coef-plot, fig.width = 11, fig.height = 12}
# >>> REMOVED: old facet_grid version (unreadable with 14 terms)
p_coef <- coef_by_year |>
  mutate(hydro_year = factor(hydro_year)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = hydro_year, y = estimate, colour = season)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey70") +
  geom_hline(data = coef_pooled, aes(yintercept = estimate, colour = season),
             linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = estimate - 1.96 * se, ymax = estimate + 1.96 * se),
                  position = position_dodge(width = 0.5), size = 0.25) +
  facet_wrap(~ term, scales = "free_y", ncol = 3) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(dry = "#b8651b", wet = "#2b6c9e")) +
  labs(x = "Hydrological year (Nov–Oct, labelled by end year)", y = "Scaled coefficient",
       colour = "Season",
       title = "Etosha SSF base model: yearly vs pooled (dashed) coefficients") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "top")

p_coef
```

## 8. Save

```{r save}
# Full model objects (large: keep local / Drive)
saveRDS(list(dry = m_base_dry, wet = m_base_wet),
        here("outputs", "etosha_ssf_base_pooled.rds"))
saveRDS(list(dry = yr_dry, wet = yr_wet),
        here("outputs", "etosha_ssf_base_by_hydroyear.rds"))

# >>> NEW: coefficient-only versions (small, git-safe). Same structure Marissa's
# resistance script expects; predict_ssf_surface() reads $coef
coef_only <- \(fit) list(coef = coef(fit$model))
saveRDS(list(dry = coef_only(m_base_dry), wet = coef_only(m_base_wet)),
        here("outputs", "etosha_ssf_base_pooled_coefonly.rds"))
saveRDS(list(dry = list(samples = yr_dry$samples, fits = map(yr_dry$fits, coef_only)),
             wet = list(samples = yr_wet$samples, fits = map(yr_wet$fits, coef_only))),
        here("outputs", "etosha_ssf_base_by_hydroyear_coefonly.rds"))

saveRDS(list(dry = sc_dry, wet = sc_wet, vars = base_vars),
        here("outputs", "etosha_ssf_base_scaling.rds"))

write_csv(coef_by_year, here("outputs", "etosha_ssf_coef_by_hydroyear.csv"))
write_csv(bind_rows(yr_dry$samples |> mutate(season = "dry"),
                    yr_wet$samples |> mutate(season = "wet")),
          here("outputs", "etosha_ssf_hydroyear_samples.csv"))

# >>> CHANGED: one ggsave, with the plot named explicitly
ggsave(here("outputs", "etosha_ssf_coef_by_hydroyear.png"), p_coef,
       width = 11, height = 12, dpi = 200)

# Sanity checks before pushing
sc_dry$var                                   # no core_dist; has elevation + water
names(yr_dry$fits); names(yr_wet$fits)
file.size(here("outputs", c("etosha_ssf_base_pooled.rds",
                            "etosha_ssf_base_by_hydroyear.rds",
                            "etosha_ssf_base_pooled_coefonly.rds",
                            "etosha_ssf_base_by_hydroyear_coefonly.rds"))) / 1e6   # MB
```

## Appendix: why core_dist was dropped

Not run when knitting (`eval = FALSE`). Run by hand to reproduce the map.

```{r core-dist-check, eval = FALSE}
core_r <- rast(here("data", "500m_data", "core_dist_rast_500m.tif"))
terra::plot(core_r == 0, col = c("grey90", "darkgreen"), main = "Core (green) = distance 0")

used <- as_tibble(ele_trk_extract_etosha) |> filter(case_)
pt_crs <- if (max(abs(used$x2_), na.rm = TRUE) < 180) "EPSG:4326" else "EPSG:32733"

set.seed(1)
samp <- used |> filter(!is.na(x2_), !is.na(y2_)) |> slice_sample(n = 20000)
v <- vect(samp, geom = c("x2_", "y2_"), crs = pt_crs) |> project(crs(core_r))

e <- ext(v) + 0.5
terra::plot(crop(core_r == 0, e), col = c("grey90", "#2e7d32"), legend = FALSE,
            main = "Etosha used GPS points over core area")
points(v[which(samp$core_dist == 0)], cex = 0.2, col = "#1f4e79")
points(v[which(samp$core_dist > 0)],  cex = 0.5, col = "#d95f02")
legend("bottomleft", c("core", "point: stored core_dist = 0", "point: stored core_dist > 0"),
       pch = c(15, 16, 16), col = c("#2e7d32", "#1f4e79", "#d95f02"), bty = "n", cex = 0.8)

# Share of steps outside the park, per elephant
used |>
  group_by(id) |>
  summarise(n_steps     = n(),
            pct_outside = round(100 * mean(core_dist > 0, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
            max_dist_km = round(max(core_dist, na.rm = TRUE) / 1000, 1)) |>
  arrange(desc(pct_outside)) |>
  print(n = Inf)
```
